tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Future in the past describes plans or expectations seen from a past moment: was / were going to (He was going to change his will), would (They knew he would announce something), was about to (We were about to leave when the lights went out), was supposed to / was due to (The lawyer was supposed to arrive at nine). These plans often didn't happen.

These plans often didn't happen.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Адвокат блідне. Лісабон тихо кладе на стіл кайданки. Пізно ввечері, коли команда повертається до Сакраменто, ти знаходиш на своєму столі старий сірий конверт. Тепер він товстіший. Усередині — копія справи, на обкладинці якої написано: «Червоний Джон. Не для стажистів».
end_good.text_pl: Prawnik blednie. Lisbon cicho kładzie na stole kajdanki. Późnym wieczorem, kiedy zespół wraca do Sacramento, znajdujesz na swoim biurku starą szarą kopertę. Teraz jest grubsza. W środku jest kopia akt, na okładce których napisano: „Red John. Nie dla stażystów”.
end_good.text_en: The lawyer turns pale. Lisbon quietly puts handcuffs on the table. Late that evening, when the team returns to Sacramento, you find the old grey envelope on your desk. It is thicker now. Inside is a copy of a case file whose cover reads: “Red John. Not for trainees.”
